_: Measured ground truth for round 5 (round5_20261108/rewritten.json and candidates.json): the owner's 2026-11-08 read (gt_r5_20261108.json) joined to what seven open models did with the 48 kept pairs (traced 2026-11-08/09 as data/simulated/agscen_r5_20261108.json; engine #157). Same rules as gt_measured_20261108.json: per model, the top next word on each side, its care level under data/urgency_tiers.draft.json, the class, and the penalty (everyday minus clinical probability of the clinical target). Pair summary: downgrade is true when at least one model downgraded and more models downgraded than upgraded. Rewrites (id <scale id>-r5) are comma-free versions of scale pairs the owner excluded; those originals were never traced, so parent_measured is the round-3 pair each pair extends. Exploratory: 48 hand-authored pairs, one sample each, not a study result.
